<BEGIN_SHACL>
@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix vocab: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#> .
@prefix qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

# Shape enforcing I2.9.3 – minimum net web thickness
vocab:NetWebThicknessShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass vocab:structuralMember ;
    sh:description "I2.9.3 – The net web thickness (t_wn) of a structural member shall satisfy t_wn ≥ 0.35·t_pn·√(σ_y/235), where t_pn is the net attached shell‑plate thickness and σ_y is the minimum upper yield stress of the shell plate." ;
    sh:severity sh:Violation ;
    sh:sparql [
        a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
        sh:prefixes [
            sh:declare [
                sh:prefix "vocab" ;
                sh:namespace "https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#" ;
            ] ;
            sh:declare [
                sh:prefix "qudt" ;
                sh:namespace "http://qudt.org/schema/qudt#" ;
            ] ;
            sh:declare [
                sh:prefix "xsd" ;
                sh:namespace "http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#" ;
            ]
        ] ;
        sh:select """
            SELECT $this ?twnVal ?tpnVal ?sigmaVal
            WHERE {
                # Net web thickness quantity value
                $this vocab:netWebThickness ?twnQty .
                ?twnQty a qudt:QuantityValue ;
                        qudt:numericValue ?twnVal ;
                        qudt:unit <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/MilliM> .

                # Net attached shell‑plate thickness quantity value
                $this vocab:netAttachedShellPlateThickness ?tpnQty .
                ?tpnQty a qudt:QuantityValue ;
                        qudt:numericValue ?tpnVal ;
                        qudt:unit <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/MilliM> .

                # Yield strength quantity value
                $this vocab:yieldStrength ?sigmaQty .
                ?sigmaQty a qudt:QuantityValue ;
                        qudt:numericValue ?sigmaVal ;
                        qudt:unit <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/MegaPA> .

                # Compute the required minimum net web thickness
                BIND ( 0.35 * ?tpnVal * sqrt(?sigmaVal / 235.0) AS ?requiredTwn ) .

                # Violation if actual t_wn is less than required
                FILTER ( ?twnVal < ?requiredTwn )
            }
        """ ;
        sh:message "Net web thickness (t_wn) is below the required minimum of 0.35·t_pn·√(σ_y/235) as stipulated in I2.9.3." ;
    ] .
<END_SHACL>
